			<Cube currency='USD' rate='2'/>
			<Cube currency='JPY' rate='0.246913'/>
			<Cube currency='GBP' rate='0.86045'/>
			<Cube currency='CHF' rate='0.9445'/>

	</Cube>

note: Hand-made from the recorded file with invented rates USD 2 and JPY 0.246913, so that JPY per USD is exactly 0.1234565, half way between two 6-place values.
